t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The player scored higher when they when right for 5 and left for 1. They scored lower on when they went for the one with the tallest hat. The yellowness of the gnome didn't seem to have an effect on the outcome.

vb_textbox.text: It seemed like the yellow gnomes with short hats were best for 5+ multiplier. If yellow wasn't a choice the nest lightest color seemed best. For the one time multiplier, it seemed like the darker or less similar to yellow color was better, but this didn't work every time. Either way if there is a short hat yellow or orange its a solid bet to pick that one, no matter the multiplier. Make sure to have your fingers on the keys and remember which part you are on.
